name: Chill Medicated CBD Gummies | Morning Green Apple
description:
Rise & Shine

These aren’t just gummies, they’re your daily boost in a bite. Each Green Apple Morning CBD gummy is filled to the brim with 25mg of CBD and 3mg of THCV for calm and clarity, plus 1mg of vitamin B12 and 50mg of ginseng to help you power through your day with focus and energy. The sweet, tangy green apple flavor is naturally sourced from fruit and vegetable juice, and the formula is vegan-friendly and gluten-free.

Made for Mornings
These aren’t your average CBD gummies. Each bite is packed with beneficial CBD and is paired with THCV for clear-headed focus and balanced energy, plus B12 and ginseng for a gentle boost.

Naturally Flavored
Naturally flavored with fruit and vegetable juice and perfectly dosed for daily use, they deliver smooth, focused energy without the crash.

Focus + Clarity
Whether you’re heading to work, hitting the gym, or diving into a busy day, this formula is designed to support mental clarity and motivation. Ginseng and B12 work synergistically to promote alertness, while THCV and CBD help you stay grounded.

Consistent, Reliable Dosing
Each gummy is precisely dosed so you get the same clean energy and calm every time. No guess work, just a steady rise into your best self.

1 Gummy = 25mg CBD + 3mg THCV + 1mg B12 + 50mg Ginseng 

MADE WITH HEMP GROWN IN THE USA
